text:
Maya: uploaded a compact legend prototype for multi-canary rows. Main asks: VoiceOver read order (status vs percentage), overflow behavior on narrow widths, and rollback CTA copy. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/NEW/compact-legend
Priya: Quick pass: SR reads 'Canary X 10%' before status. Status should be announced first. Recommend DOM order change + CSS ordering to keep visual layout. Overflow must be keyboard operable (button with aria-expanded).
Jordan: Implementation note: put status earlier in DOM, use CSS order to preserve visuals. Add aria-describedby from row to status id. For overflow use a '+N' button that opens a popover; keep rollback CTA visible.
Maya: On mobile the chips wrap and push rollback down. Overflow preferred to avoid vertical growth. Also 'Paused' pill contrast fails in dark theme (~3.8:1).
Luca: I'll add feature flag compact_legend_v2 and analytics hook for CTA copy A/B: control='Roll back', variant='Revert'. Tag events deploy.rollback.click and deploy.rollback.confirmed with label copy_variant.
Priya: Accessibility checklist for devs: 1) status element early in DOM, 2) visual parity via CSS order, 3) overflow as accessible button with aria-expanded and focus styles, 4) hidden items aria-hidden, 5) contrast >= 4.5:1 for critical pills, 6) aria-describedby for undo window text if shown.
Sam: Plan: Jordan implements DOM/CSS this sprint, Luca wires analytics and flag, QA validates keyboard/SR on staging next week, run small canary A/B on CTA copy.
deploy-bot: staging build: https://staging.redwood.ai/deploys/compact-legend-flagged
Maya: I'll update figma with DOM annotations and a narrow-width artboard and ping Priya when done.
